visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of three colorful layered coffee drinks on a wooden board and a dark stone coaster. A man with shoulder-length wavy hair and a blue denim shirt appears, enthusiastically holding a massive, cut-open watermelon slice in a bright kitchen studio with white walls and green cabinets. (2) He moves to a counter to prepare the watermelon cold brew, blending red watermelon chunks in a clear pitcher until liquid. He then interacts with a sleek, silver and black De'Longhi Eletta Explore coffee machine, pressing the digital touch screen to select the cold brew function. (3) The camera focuses on the machine's dispenser as dark coffee flows into a glass already containing the pink watermelon juice and ice cubes, creating a distinct red and brown layered effect. He tastes the drink with a glass straw, looking satisfied. (4) Transitioning to the second recipe, he holds a bowl of chopped green guava. He blends the guava with water and sugar, then pours the pale green juice through a fine-mesh sieve into a glass. (5) He returns to the coffee machine, which dispenses a fresh layer of coffee over the guava juice, topped with a small guava slice garnish. He holds the layered green and brown drink toward the camera before taking a sip. (6) For the final drink, he blends bright orange mango chunks. He attaches a specialized white milk container labeled 'LatteCrema Cool' to the machine. The screen shows 'Cold Milk Foam' being prepared. (7) White, frothy milk and dark coffee pour over the orange mango puree in a double-walled glass. He sprinkles mango bits on top. (8) In the conclusion, he stands by the machine, gesturing broadly with his hands and laughing dramatically while explaining the 50+ drink options shown on the display. A promotional screen with campaign text appears at the end.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video starts with high-energy, upbeat electronic pop music featuring synthesized percussion and a bright, major-mode melody. A male voice speaks rapidly with high enthusiasm. (2) A mechanical whirring sound of a blender is heard briefly as the host discusses fruit. (3) A series of high-pitched digital beeps follows as the touch screen on the coffee machine is operated. (4) A loud, grinding mechanical noise indicates the coffee machine processing beans, followed by a steady, bubbling sound of liquid pouring into a glass. (5) A distinct slurping sound through a straw is followed by a sharp intake of breath and an exaggerated 'Oh!' of satisfaction. (6) The process repeats with similar blending whirs, beeps, and pouring sounds for the second recipe. (7) For the third recipe, a soft hissing and bubbling sound accompanies the milk frothing process. (8) The final phase features a fast-paced summary of machine features, ending with the host's high-pitched, staccato laughter that rings out over the fading music.
